summary: AIG filed a routine Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing the closing of an ordinary investment-grade debt offering: €625 million of 4.250% Notes due 2031 and €500 million of 4.750% Notes due 2036, sold under a September 15, 2026 underwriting agreement led by Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, BNP Paribas and Citigroup. Supplemental indentures with BNY Mellon as trustee, note forms and a Sullivan & Cromwell validity opinion were filed as exhibits. No equity, merger, tender or restructuring element exists; this is a plain-vanilla capital-markets takedown, not a special situation.
